channel.title: Device on Solarhub Help Center
channel.description: Recent content in Device on Solarhub Help Center

item.title: Search or filter devices
item.description: 1. Device search link Under “Device” of the APP, you can search for devices by device serial number 2. Device filtering link Two conditions for filtering link Filter by device type Filter by device online status

item.title: Device Details
item.description: Entrance link Click on the device in the device list interface to enter the device overview page Function Overview link1. Device Alias link 2. Remote upgrade link Function to be completed 3. Parameter setting link Parameter settings support different settings for different types of parameters 4. Unbind device link All historical data will be deleted after unbinding the device

item.title: Device History
item.description: Click a device in the device list to enter the device details Click to enter history from the menu below Historical data supports four views: day, month, year, and all In the chart, you can view the data at a certain point in time by continuously pressing

item.title: Device Event
item.description: Click a device in the device list to enter the device details Click to enter the event from the menu below Events have two states: Occurring and Recovered. You can filter by clicking the title above Click on an event to view detailed information about the event
